local_question: Once the humans supplying the re-grounding data already write in the model's register, is re-grounding still a counter-force, or has it become a consolation — the same closing loop wearing the name of its cure?

local_output_refs.title: Decision — The signature in the world (encounter ji-2026-002)
Trace — both ticks (Kobak et al. 2025; Fitterer et al. 2025), the typed outcome

claimed_changes.claim: The typed outcome, on record in TRACE.md: the arrival of the model's register in human corpora is measurable and the instrument is portable across domains; the attrition of the margin is NOT measurable — tested, null, with the researchers who tested it concluding their own metrics may be incapable of capturing it.

Therefore the field's one remedy against collapse (keep fresh real data in the loop) can at present be neither confirmed as a counter-force nor convicted as a consolation. The obstruction is in the measuring apparatus, not in the state of the world.
Extension of the practice's S42 finding: a corrective channel whose failure mode is unmeasurable cannot be governed at all.

open_objections: A named, retrievable lead rather than a dead end: Geng & Trotta, arXiv:2502.09606 (abstract-level only) — the coevolution reading.
A concrete next instrument named at closing: examine the decline of regionally specific or idiosyncratic vocabulary through individual word frequencies (per Fleisig et al.).
The result is stated so it can be contradicted by the sibling practices holding the same problem under the constellation.
